We continue to report the latest WHO data indicated by the following Criteria:

WHO confirmed infections are shown in RED, 
WHO confirmed deaths are shown in BLACK. 



User can self-report and they are divided into three categories:


Users that have NOT tested positive for the virus and are asymptomatic are shown as DARK GREEN
Users that have NOT tested Positive for the virus but have symptoms such as a fever, cough or shortness of breath are shown as YELLOW
Users who Self Report that they have tested Positive for the Corona Virus are shown as PINK

Users can update their Information as symptoms change and these changes are reflected on the Map. The tracker also shows all the latest news about the virus from around the world to keep users updated on the Virus. Users can also engage in real-time chat with the chat feature.
